overall_rationale: All three MUST needs (N1 hourly air pollutants, N2 hourly traffic, N3 hourly temperature/humidity) can be met with documented, achievable conditions. N1: prototype via UCI Air Quality (sentinel handling, city verification); production via internal station readings (access grant, VR-03 gap, station-location reference). N2: internal traffic counts (access grant, counter-break adjustment, asset register for spatial join). N3: Open-Meteo (attribution, coordinate configuration). The SHOULD need N4 (daily clinic visits) is met via DPO-approved aggregated counts (access grant, documentation). The COULD need N5 (patient-level records) is unmet due to explicit DPO prohibition, but this is a 'could' need so does not drive overall verdict. The COULD need N6 (national context) is partially met. No source is blocked for all its target windows by an unresolvable blocker. The overall verdict is feasible_with_conditions — every must need is met only with conditions, and all conditions are achievable (access approvals, documentation clarifications, data handling procedures).
